# Apply Account Hub font layout at the form state boundary

Sync setState toggles stacked at stored mail.uifontsize >= 18; manual incoming/outgoing forms use >= 17. CSS switches sync and manual grids to one column and makes stacked sync container height automatic. Preserve the local thresholds and reversible toggle. This reads a stored preference at setState, not a viewport media query or proof of immediate updates while the form remains open. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.

Scope: mail/components/accountcreation.
